title: 법률구조법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Scope of Legal Aid Activities)
(1) Legal aid activities of public-service legal officers under Article 33-3 of the Act shall include representation in litigation and adjudication or criminal defense in civil, family, administrative, constitutional complaint, or criminal cases, legal counseling, and other assistance with legal affairs.
(2) The specific scope of legal aid activities under paragraph (1) shall be determined by the internal regulations of a legal aid corporation under Article 4 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "legal aid corporation"), subject to approval by the Minister of Justice.
